project.name: Numou Integration - Aggregator
project.description:
Phase 1 integration layer (Docs/Plan/base01.md §12, §13, §P1-16).
The whole point of this layer, from base00.md:
"Numou can consume VehicleLocationUpdated, DeliveryCompleted, VehicleBreakdownReported without forcing PT ABC to migrate to Numou FMS."
That requires the platform to model other systems as first-class participants-with-endpoints, not as ad-hoc HTTP calls buried in a domain service:
api outbound API contracts Numou offers webhook inbound/outbound push subscriptions connector named integrations (external FMS, ERP, PSP, 3PL) external-system a partner's system, its endpoints, auth and scope partner the participant behind the system
integration-api is the contract modules compile against; the SPI is what HTTP/queue/credential machinery implements.
